sources.contract: capabilitiesIdentity and requestKey define the current context; activeProposalOwner filters by exact request key; startCandidateProposal checks proposal base identity and fallback preview receipt/output/rows; cancel and replacement invalidate owner/generation; beginApply checks current owner, generation, resource snapshot, and applicability; finishApply updates client-side proposal state.
constructionProposalIsApplicable requires READY, a proposal id, exact output/snapshot/draft identity, preview receipt equal to proposal id, preview output equal to current output, and non-null rows.
resourceFor owns the proposal snapshot, abort signal, refresh epoch, and stale loader publication behavior used by useConstructionLifecycle.
